items.prompt: An arithmetic progression has first term 5 and common difference 3. Find u_10 and the sum of the first 10 terms.

points.text: Uses u_n = a x r^(n - 1) to get u_5 = 8 x (1/2)^4 = 1/2
States the sum-to-infinity condition on r (its size below 1) and uses S = a / (1 - r) to get 8 / (1/2) = 16

items.prompt: A geometric progression has first term 8 and ratio 1/2. Find u_5 and its sum to infinity.

points.text: Writes A = pi r^2 and applies the chain rule dA/dt = 2 pi r dr/dt
